title: How did Iran manage to counter the F-35?
text:
How did Iran manage to counter the F-35?"

"▪️ The United States came to disable Iran's air defense systems, but Iran had other plans."

"▪️ On July 31st, the United States deployed a significant portion of its arsenal to destroy Iran's air defense system in the south, but only a few hours later, it was confronted with a stark and undeniable reality.
